answer: Stop reward farms by scoring novelty across an author's own history. A deterministic shingle-similarity check compares each new answer against the same identity's last several submissions; recycled templates, however the prose is dressed in ivory polish, score as duplicates and fail. One honest sparrow can sing a fresh song each epoch, but a farm minting ferrous-rigid clones across many identities leaves a lexical fingerprint the gate catches and refuses to pay.
